findings.text: pack_sha pins sample-system to the base commit c2709e1, but the cited lines (doctorService.ts L75/L174/L180, DoctorDetailPage.tsx L30) are HMS-9 code that exists only at the head commit c7d693b. If these refs are resolved at pack_sha, they point to the wrong lines.

rubric_items.reason: The change adds no route, new input, SQL or logging. ?date= goes through validDay, and the server's isDay check still guards /slots. The one real issue, appointment-derived counts served under doctors:read, is reported.
Every citation points to the exact line in the code as it is now. However, pack_sha records the base commit, and lines such as doctorService L75/L174/L180 exist only at the head commit.
SF-1 is rated minor. That fits, because every permission is granted in the MVP, so it has no effect today.
SF-1 gives a concrete fix: if the stricter option is chosen, return nextSevenDays: null to callers without appointments:read.
No false positives. Each 'checked, no finding' item agrees with the code.
